versions.changelog:
Initial release of emotion-copywriter—an emotional copywriting generation tool for social media.

- Supports multiple emotion types with scenario triggers and typical phrasing
- Provides structured copywriting templates (three-part, contrast, self-deprecating, punchline)
- Includes rhetorical techniques to enhance emotional impact
- Adapts copy content for major platforms like Weibo, WeChat Moments, Xiaohongshu, and Instagram
- Outputs complete copywriting samples and optimization suggestions
- Predicts emotional resonance and viral potential
